title: Noise operator on signs
statement: For a real parameter $\rho$ and a real-valued function $f$ on the signs, define its noise transform by $T_\rho f(x)=\operatorname{signEvenCoeff}(f)+\rho\,\operatorname{signOddCoeff}(f)\operatorname{signValue}(x)$ for each sign $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the signs to $\mathbb{R}$
caveat: The defining formula uses the even and odd sign coefficients and the sign value, whose definitions were not included in the supplied context; their standard meanings are therefore not established here.
